result.description: SEO platform for backlink, keyword, rank tracking, site audit and SERP data, exposed via API v3.
result.auth_detail: API v3: workspace API key sent as Authorization: Bearer. OAuth2 only via Ahrefs Connect (app must be approved/activated) and the hosted MCP.
result.access_detail: API on eligible paid plans (Lite+); other plans get only limited free test queries. Only workspace owners/admins create keys. Extra units are Enterprise-only. OAuth public apps via Ahrefs Connect need approval and activation.
result.api_notes: API v3 covers Site Explorer, Keywords Explorer, SERP Overview, Rank Tracker, Site Audit, Batch Analysis, Brand Radar, Social Media Management, Content Helper, management and usage endpoints. Unit-metered, min 50 units per request.
result.blocker: No free tier: users need a paid Lite+ plan, and the API key is created by a workspace admin. Per-user OAuth needs Ahrefs Connect approval. The official MCP forbids use through custom scripts or bridges.

evidence.quote: Provide it in the Authorization header when making requests: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`.
Ahrefs API is available on [eligible paid plans](https://ahrefs.com/pricing). On all other plans, you'll still have access to a [limited set of free test queries](./free-test-queries.md).
Once your app is approved and activated, production requests will consume units according to the normal cost rules.
Currently, API v3 allows you to pull data from the Site Explorer, Keywords Explorer, SERP Overview, Rank Tracker, Site Audit, Brand Radar, Social Media Management and Content Helper endpoints
Ahrefs provides a hosted MCP server that allows users with a Lite plan or higher to connect their Ahrefs account to supported AI tools.
Using the external MCP endpoint via custom scripts, bridges, or standalone HTTP/JSON-RPC clients is **unsupported and not permitted.**
